recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11488 unless a future workflow-pattern issue changes the set or naming of the logical models.
issue_request: FHIR-11488 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the workflow module. It asked to replace the DSTU2-era introduction sentence saying the specification defined two logical models, Request and Event, with wording saying it defines three logical models: Definition, Request, and Event.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the correction was applied in svn @10141. In git history, commit d3c64ad7c6df6bb51d8fbba3e4a173f2a4c2398e on 2016-11-08 is the matching application commit; its subject lists #11488 and its patch changed source/workflow-module.html from "two logical models" to "three logical models" with links to Definition, Request, and Event.
additional_context: The current build source still includes source/workflow-module.html through source/hierarchy.xml under the Workflow page. Later edits have reflowed and expanded the surrounding introduction, but the relevant sentence still says the specification defines three logical models and links Definition, Request, and Event. Searches found no remaining current source occurrence of "two logical models" and no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because the active workflow module source already contains the requested three-model wording.
